title: Will We Meet Again? - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Will We Meet Again? trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Will We Meet Again? phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Beating her unlocks the third phase of the encounter, so a first attempt that ends early is not the same fight as the one the trophy is named after.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat Mu Xiaokui, the Young Mistress of the Order.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 8 of 36 on the list - before it The Shattered Mirror · after it The Lion's Spirit Lives On. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
